name: loop-kit
description: Flow and turn-gate loop plugin for message interview, flow design, main-flow lifecycle, and active turn continuity.

interface.shortDescription: Flow design plus turn-gated continuity for multi-flow agent work.
interface.longDescription: Provides flow for message interview, flow design, main-flow lifecycle, and handoff conditions, plus turn-gate for phase prefixes, verification, next-flow routing, and active turn continuity.
defaultPrompt: Use flow as message interview -> flow design -> main flow -> handoff condition, then use turn-gate to keep the turn open until I explicitly stop.
Use phase prefixes for visible phase-start or meaningful progress messages, and treat reporting as pre-intake for the next user decision.
If a later user message arrives after an explicit or accidental stop, reactivate turn-gate and start fresh intake.
